Threads

Each thread of the calendar, a page a thread: its entries, its own and those it holds by also, in the calendar’s order, each as the calendar gives it. A large thread is in parts by date. A thread’s subthreads are named at the head of its page, each with a page of its own. In the thread index’s order. The threads in the calendar: the calendar’s index.

Places

A page a place, built from the entries: a nation’s holds the entries that took place there and those that concern it by its people, its places or its threads, each marked which; a State’s, a province’s or a city’s, those that took place there and those that carry its tag. A province is as it was in 1966; a city has a page where it has 50 entries or more. Each page is laid out as a thread’s, and a large one is in parts by date.
